reuse.why: Hooks into the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked precondition that every link path (GoCardless, linkExternalAccount, Enable Banking) already calls before any write or sync.

duplication.why: Adds a single check in one shared guard; nothing is repeated per provider.

placement.why: Correct layer (server link precondition run before saveLinkedAccount), though the closed-account rule is folded into a function named for the one-link-per-bank rule rather than its own guard or a renamed precondition.

scope.why: Twelve added lines, strictly the requested rule.

maintainability.why: Simple and covers all paths, but the guard's name no longer describes what it asserts, which will mislead future readers.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkExternalAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount
